releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.63 cleans up Files exactly as approved. File Summary and the PDF/Images/Videos counters are removed completely from Category, so the tab starts directly with My Categories. Search now has only All, Documents, Images and Videos; Documents groups PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Image results show real local thumbnails and video results show cached frame thumbnails with a small play overlay, while document results keep their existing file-type icons and thumbnail failures safely fall back to icons. All existing file search, category, scan, open and indexing behavior remains intact.
